capabilities: Share a note online with one click
Encrypt notes end-to-end with AES-256-CBC and single-use keys
Use the free Noteshare.space host or self-host the storage service
Store encrypted notes for 31 days on the default host
extras: Both the plugin and the Noteshare.space service are in beta; beta installs go through BRAT. No account or API key is needed.
motivation: The author was tired of finding third-party services to quickly share Markdown notes written in Obsidian.
problem: Sharing a single Obsidian note quickly means finding and configuring a third-party service, since Obsidian has no built-in encrypted ad-hoc sharing.

relations.evidence: By default, notes are stored on my companion project, Noteshare.space.

summary: One-click sharing of a note to a web link via end-to-end encrypted upload to a hosted or self-hosted storage service.
